slug: 百岁成魔开局拿捏妖女命脉
content_zh:
;;
“诸位同门，接下来是本次拍卖会的压轴大戏——先天纯阳圣体！”
合欢宗地下黑市。
拍卖师歇斯底里的声音，在空旷的会场上空回荡。
“千年难遇！无上大药！”
“得此炉鼎，一夜破境，如饮甘泉！”
台下，无数合欢宗妖女眼神狂热。
数十道如狼似虎的神识，迫不及待地扫向那被厚重黑布遮掩的巨大铁笼。
“别废话！快掀开！”
“让老娘看看是何等水灵的少年郎！”
拍卖师嘴角一勾，猛地扯下黑布。
刺目的聚光灯瞬间砸在铁笼上。
下一秒，全场陡然一静。
铁笼里，根本没有鲜衣怒马的少年郎。
只有一个须发皆白、满脸老年斑、身形佝偻的老头。
他正站在原地颤颤巍巍，仿佛一阵阴风吹过，就能当场圆寂。
铁笼中，李寒山脸色木然。
“苍天啊，别人穿越都是俊美无双，凭什么让我穿成个百岁老登？”
刚穿过来，半截身子都已经埋进了黄土。
本以为这辈子就这么完了，谁知更倒霉的还在后头——他竟被丧心病狂的合欢宗抓来当了炉鼎。

完蛋了。
他听其他被抓的人说过，合欢宗的炉鼎，最后都会被活生生吸成人干。
李寒山低头看了看自己枯树皮一样的手，在心底干笑两声。
唯一值得庆幸的是，这帮如狼似虎的合欢宗妖女，应该不愿意啃自己这根老葱吧？
然而，短暂的死寂后。
台下突然爆发出一阵掀翻屋顶的喧哗！
“天呐！竟然是活到了百岁、元阳未泄的老翁！”
一个身材火辣的红衣妖女双眼猩红，猛地站起身，声音都在发抖。
“老蚌生珠，越老越醇！不敢想他体内的纯阳之气已经沉淀到了何等恐怖的地步！”
另一个美艳少妇推开男宠，舔了舔猩红的嘴唇，目光贪婪得像是在看一块绝世珍宝。
“这老头归老娘了！我出一百灵石！”
“五百灵石！老娘要了！”
“放屁！五百就想买绝品人材？我出一千！”
“两千！谁敢跟我抢，出了黑市我杀谁！”
疯了。

"Fellow disciples, next is the grand finale of this auction - the Innate Pure Yang Holy Body!"
Hehuan Sect's underground black market.
The auctioneer's hysterical voice echoed over the empty venue.
"Once in a thousand years! The ultimate medicine!"
"Getting this cauldron and breaking through the realm in one night is like drinking from a sweet spring!"
Under the stage, countless enchantress girls from the Hehuan Sect had wild eyes.
Dozens of wolf-like consciousnesses rushed towards the huge iron cage covered by thick black cloth.
"Stop talking nonsense! Open it quickly!"
"Show me what a handsome young man you are!"
The auctioneer curled his lips and suddenly pulled off the black cloth.
The dazzling spotlight instantly hit the iron cage.
The next second, the whole place suddenly fell silent.
In the iron cage, there was no young man in bright clothes and an angry horse.
There was only an old man with white beard and hair, a face full of age spots, and a stooped body.
He was standing there trembling, as if a gust of cold wind could pass away on the spot.
In the iron cage, Li Hanshan's face was dull.
"Oh my god, everyone else who traveled through time is so handsome, why should I dress like a centenarian?"
As soon as I walked through, half of my body was already buried in the loess.
I thought that this life would be over, but who knew that something even worse was to come - he was captured and used as a furnace by the crazy Hehuan Sect.
It's over.
He heard from other people who were arrested that the furnaces of the Hehuan Sect would eventually be sucked alive and fucked.
Li Hanshan looked down at his hands that looked like dry tree bark, and laughed in his heart.
The only good thing is that these wolf-like and tiger-like Hehuan sect bewitching girls are not willing to chew on this old onion, right?
However, after a brief silence.
Suddenly, a roof-shattering noise broke out from the audience!
"Oh my god! He's actually an old man who has lived to be a hundred years old and still has his vitality intact!"
A hot-looking seductress in red with scarlet eyes stood up suddenly, her voice trembling.
"Old clams grow pearls, the older they get, the mellower they become! I can't believe how terrifying the pure Yang energy in his body has settled!"
Another beautiful young woman pushed away her male favorite and licked her scarlet lips, her eyes as greedy as if she were looking at a unique treasure.
"This old man belongs to my mother! I will give you a hundred spiritual stones!"
"Five hundred spiritual stones! I want it!"
"Fart! You want to buy a top-notch talent for five hundred? I'll give you one thousand!"
"Two thousand! Whoever dares to rob me will be killed by me after leaving the black market!"
Crazy.
